source_text: Et congregata est aqua, et apparuit arida. Et vocavit Deus aridam terram. Sicut arida segregata aqua iam terra nominatur, ita corpora nostra, si vitia segregentur, iam non arida sed terra appellabuntur, Deo ferre potentes. Qui aridus manet et spinas profert, esca ignis efficitur; qui se terram fructiferam exhibet, speret terram fluentem lac et mel.
pass_a_gloss: And gathered is water, and appeared dry-land. And called God dry-land earth. As dry-land separated from-water already earth is-named, so bodies our, if vices be-separated, already not dry-land but earth will-be-called, to-God to-bear able. Who dry remains and thorns brings-forth, food of-fire is-made; who himself earth fruit-bearing shows, let-hope earth flowing milk and honey.
pass_b_english: The water was gathered, and the dry land appeared. [[God called the dry land Earth >> Bible:Genesis 1:10]]. As dry land, once separated from water, is already named earth, so our bodies, if vices are separated, will no longer be called dry land but earth, able to bear for God. Whoever remains dry and brings forth thorns becomes food for fire; whoever shows himself fruitful earth may hope for [[a land flowing with milk and honey >> Bible:Exodus 3:8]].
